headline: Spaniards have had enough: Mass protests after an 87-year-old was evicted
summary: Mass protests in Spain followed the eviction of an 87-year-old. Growing housing speculation is described as having created a crisis in housing affordability that has persisted for years.
why: Housing costs shape household spending, mortgage markets and political pressure on property regulation, which matter for real estate and bank investors.
